notes: Global brands that phishing most often imitates, used ONLY for lookalike detection (URL-01/URL-02/URL-04 in backend/src/services/domain-matching). Deliberately separate from trusted-domains.json, which is an allowlist and gives no lookalike protection. Adding a domain here can only ADD warnings about OTHER domains that imitate it, never mark anything safe. Rules for entries: the brand label must be distinctive (not an everyday word like 'apple' or 'office', which would flag unrelated sites) and at least 5 letters (shorter labels are one edit away from ordinary words). Only the brand's primary domain is listed: TLD swaps (amazon.co.uk) and the brand as a subdomain (facebook.github.io) are never flagged, because brands legitimately own and use both. A typo match (one or two edits) must also keep the brand's first letter, so finance.com is not read as binance.com or email.com as gmail.com.
